style: background: var(--color-white); padding: 80px 0; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; .container { width: 100%; } .cards-more__wrap { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; } .cards-more__title { font-size: 32px; color: var(--navy-900); font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 50px; text-align: center; } .cards-more__list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr)); width: 100%; gap: 25px; padding: 0; list-style: none; margin-bottom: 50px; } .card { border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-white); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); overflow: hidden; transition: all 0.3s ease; &:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.12); } } .card__img { height: 180px; background: var(--sky-200); position: relative; img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } } .card__content { padding: 20px; h3 { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 10px 0; color: var(--navy-950); } p { font-size: 14px; color: var(--slate-600); line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; } } .cards-more__btn { padding: 15px 40px; background: var(--navy-400); color: var(--color-white); border: none; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; letter-spacing: 1px; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); &:hover { background: var(--navy-900); transform: scale(1.05); } &._full { background: var(--navy-950); } }
